answers.core: The problems I mentioned are flaws of the main 3D scene importer itself. I believe that these issues should be fixed directly, rather than via external add-ons.
answers.workaround: Some individual usecases can be worked around with editor scripts, however these usually end up being the same across projects and really just indicate a flaw of the existing system.

title: Add new external 3D scene import hints to allow for better collision shape generation
